No data exfiltration, dynamic code evaluation, or unsafe operations occur when the file is sourced.

Thus, running `makepkg --printsrcinfo` on this PKGBUILD is safe, as it will only parse static metadata without executing any build or versioning logic.

The script does not exfiltrate data or modify system files outside the package installation.

The maintainer information and URL are present, and the license (AGPL-3.0-or-later) is open source. The package conflicts with itself to prevent file overlap, and provides a virtual package name. These are all normal packaging conventions. No evidence of supply-chain tampering or injected malicious code is found.
